description: Build a canonical Dimensions web profile URL from an entity type and Dimensions ID. Use this instead of inventing paths — researcher profiles are /details/entities/publication/author/{id} (not /discover/researcher/{id}); organization profiles are /details/organization/{id}. search_*, get_by_*, similar_documents, and facet_query already attach profile_url when possible.

entityType.description: Entity type with a web profile (e.g. researchers, organizations, publications)

name: construct_profile_url
title: Build Dimensions link
